items.title: The Unlikely Place at the Center of China’s AI Boom
items.summary: Cheap energy, abundant land, and proximity to Beijing have turned a city in Inner Mongolia into a crucial hub for data centers.
items.author: Zeyi Yang

items.title: The Single English County Saying No to Palantir
items.summary: The UK government is facing calls to cancel a sprawling health care contract with Palantir. The region of Greater Manchester insists it can do a better job itself.
items.author: Joel Khalili, Matt Burgess
